questions.stem: Avec l’indice «Identify the tense used to report a future event / Think of a future viewed from a past moment. / Tense required by a reported…», quelle option est réellement appuyée par le texte ?

options.text: Use the conditionnel to show a future seen from the past
Use the present tense because the statement is still true today
options.misconception: confuses reported time with present fact

options.text: Use the imparfait to match the reporting verb in the past

options.text: Use the passe compose to mark a completed action

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Word order inside a reported question
questions.learningObjective: Reorder words in an indirect question

stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. « ou est le quai » Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: La consigne de cet item est «Reorder words in an indirect question / Drop the subject-verb inversion. / Word order inside a reported question». Quelle réponse en découle ?

answer.exemplar: In an indirect question the subject comes before the verb, so 'ou est le quai' becomes 'ou le quai est', dropping the inversion of direct speech.

questions.explanation: Indirect questions use declarative word order. Keeping the inversion of direct speech is the tempting error, but it is reserved for direct questions.
